jk-balboa-park.note: Carries the J and K from their boarding stop at San Jose & Geneva (SF:17778) down San Jose Ave to Balboa Park's centre at Geneva, where the M passes, so the three lines meet at the station. The track exists (the lead to the yard at Geneva), but no J or K trip in 511's data runs it.

t-market-4th.note: 511's shape jogs 35 m west along Market before turning up Stockton. The Central Subway runs straight down 4th St across Market and curves up into Stockton, arriving at O'Farrell. The curve is drawn tangent to both streets; it follows the user's description and has not been checked against as-built drawings.
